interpretations: For patients with a `U-PRO = '-'` record and an `RA = '-'` record, allowing the same record to satisfy both conditions, calculate each patient’s average nonmissing `PT` and average of `TAT - TAT2` for records where both values are present, using all their laboratory records; then average each set of available patient averages across patients and return the two unrounded values in one row.

For the same eligible patients, use all their laboratory records to calculate each patient’s average nonmissing `PT`, average nonmissing `TAT`, and average nonmissing `TAT2`; subtract the two TAT averages for each patient, then average the available patient results for each measure and return the two unrounded values in one row.
queries:
WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN `U-PRO` = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
       AND SUM(CASE WHEN RA = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
),
patient_averages AS (
    SELECT l.ID,
           AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt,
           AVG(CASE
                   WHEN l.TAT IS NOT NULL AND l.TAT2 IS NOT NULL
                   THEN l.TAT - l.TAT2
               END) AS avg_tat_difference
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN eligible AS e ON e.ID = l.ID
    GROUP BY l.ID
)
SELECT AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt,
       AVG(avg_tat_difference) AS avg_tat_difference
FROM patient_averages

WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        AVG(PT) AS avg_pt,
        AVG(TAT) AS avg_tat,
        AVG(TAT2) AS avg_tat2
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_pt) AS average_pt,
    AVG(avg_tat - avg_tat2) AS average_tat_difference
FROM patient_averages
